name: Scentra
description: Scentra found her forever home with a great family. She was the best running hound we had to date, and we are excited to hear how she does in the future!

name: San "Sam" Frediano
description: Sam went to his new home in Virginia with a very friendly family with many fellow working hounds.

name: Buddy
description: Buddy found his forever home and is settling in with his new family.

name: Donny
description: Donny is loved in his new home and enjoys plenty of walks and couch time.

name: Randy
description: Randy was a wonderful hound to place and is thriving with his adopters.

name: Monica & Rachel
description: Monica and Rachel came from Hertford County NC. They were adopted together.

name: Bo
description: Bo is a well mannered hound who loves to be outside, going on walks, and playing with friends.

name: Tutter
description: Tutter was an awesome hound to foster and got along well with everyone. He loved to eat, go for walks, and bark up trees at squirrels.
